Name: Always Scroll Map
Author: bcmpinc
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Makes the map scroll past the edge of the map. Useful for:[list]
[*] planting seeds while walking;
[*] doing out-of-bounds glitches;
[*] checking for out of bounds objects.
[/list]It can be toggled on/off using the '[code];[/code]' button (or any other button you specify in [code]config.json[/code]).

[size=4][b]Config[/b][/size]
[i]Note: run Stardew Valley once with this mod enabled to generate the [code]config.json[/code] file.[/i][list]
[*] [code]EnabledIndoors[/code]: Should the mod be enabled in indoor areas upon loading the game? Default = true.
[*] [code]EnabledOutdoors[/code]: Should the mod be enabled in outdoor areas upon loading the game? Default = false.
[*] [code]ToggleScroll[/code]: The key used to toggle always scroll map. Default = [code]OemSemicolon[/code].
[/list][size=4][b]Dependencies[/b][/size]
This mod requires the following mods to be installed:[list]
[*] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3213]StardewHack[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] - optional
[/list][size=4][b]Known bugs[/b][/size]
Please report bugs on [url=https://github.com/bcmpinc/StardewHack/issues]GitHub[/url].[list]
[*] On the bus-stop map, the HUD also moves when scrolling past the edge of the map.
[*] On a day with falling leaves, the leaves disappear when scrolling past the west edge of the map.
[/list][size=4][b]Changes[/b][/size]

[/list]
